plugins.name: task-pipeline
plugins.description: Flujo de trabajo guiado: bootstrap con /task-init -> plan mode -> plan en pending -> grilling -> design-review -> tareas en Gherkin -> scenario-coverage -> TDD -> gate de mutation testing -> gate de cierre fact-checker (verifica afirmaciones). Skills /task-init, /plan-task, /mutation, /doctor, /fact-checker, grilling, design-review y scenario-coverage.
